# Thirza Abernethy

[Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society)

## Appearance

Thirza possesses a tall, slender, and lean frame with sharp contours and angles. She has a pale face with lined cheeks, alongside rough, labor-calloused hands. Her dark hair, which has grown increasingly silvered over time, is consistently bound at the back in a tight, firm bun. Though she once anticipated becoming completely blind, her failing eyesight has significantly improved and stabilized, remaining at a state where it is unlikely to fail further or improve dramatically.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P24](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0024), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P39](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0039), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), +4 more_

## Personality

Thirza Abernethy is a practical, rational, and composed woman with an unyielding sense of morality, who refuses on principle to express opinions regarding ministers. Often stern, rigid, and restrained, she considers any intense display of emotion improper and tends to be strict, gloomy, and fault-finding. Despite her reserved nature and lack of a refined appreciation of beauty, she possesses a underlying sense of humor, a soft and kind disposition that can turn mellow, and a deep fondness for [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). She consistently attaches moral lessons to her words, disapproves of eating quickly with large bites, and loathes cats. Driven by an uncompromising commitment to duty, she takes immense delight in the prospect of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) marrying [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md). Professionally and domestically skilled, Thirza is known for making yellow plum preserves, renowned homemade currant wine, and circular braided rugs.

## History

Thirza Abernethy lived at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) for sixty years after reaching adulthood, having previously wallpapered a spare bedroom with her brother Obed's help. When [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) brought an orphan girl named [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) by mistake instead of a boy, Thirza initially insisted the child be returned to the asylum, but she soon agreed to keep her. She provided religious guidance to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and raised her through various childhood misadventures, including cutting Nell's hair short after a disastrous dyeing incident. Thirza later supported Nell's academic ambitions, celebrating her top entrance exam results and offering comfort when [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) died following a sudden bank failure. To help manage her failing eyesight and keep [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), Thirza agreed to have [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) move in while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) attended college. Over the years, she also took in two orphaned twins, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) Farrow, raising them permanently after their father's trust fund was established. Thirza watched [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) mature, eventually helping prepare for Nell's wedding to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) in the [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) orchard. She later traveled to [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor)—her first journey of sixty miles from home—to visit the couple for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) and assist [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) through pregnancy and childbirth.

## Quotes

> "At minimum, provide me with someone native born. A risk will exist, regardless of whom we obtain. Nevertheless, my mind will be more at ease and my night’s sleep will be sounder if we obtain a born Canadian."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)

> "No. A boy is what we need to assist Obed on the farm. To us, a girl would be useless. Remove your hat. On the hall table, I’ll place it along with your bag."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)

> "Now, strip off your clothes as fast as possible and get into bed. In a little while, I’ll return to fetch the candle. Leaving you to extinguish it on your own is too risky. It’s probable you’d burn down the house."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P44](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0044)

> "Obed Abernethy, my belief is that you have been enchanted by that child! It is as clear as day to me that your desire is to retain her."
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061)

> "Obed Abernethy, my surprise at you is great. Though aware of Nell’s terrible conduct, you still defend her! Next, I expect you will claim that no punishment whatsoever should be given to her!"
>
> — Thirza Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) is a longstanding neighbor and friend of Thirza, with whom she also traveled on a boat trip into town. [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) frequently visits [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to offer advice, opinions, and warnings, such as questioning Thirza's decision to take in an orphan. Though Agatha's harsh criticisms of Nell's appearance initially cause friction, Thirza later accompanies [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to Agatha's house to oversee an apology that restores peace between the households.

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--thirza-abernethy.md)

Thirza acts as a guardian, mentor, and maternal figure to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who lives with her at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Though initially adamant that the orphan girl be sent back because they had requested a boy, Thirza quickly grows fond of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and decides to keep her. She strictly directs Nell's upbringing through religious lessons and house rules, but their bond develops into a deep mutual affection.

Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) is an acquaintance of Thirza who was involved in consulting and arranging the placement of the orphan child. ### [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/robin-farrow--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) is Thirza's third cousin once removed, whom she took in as a guardian alongside his twin sister. Thirza enforces strict discipline on the highly mischievous boy, frequently punishing him for his pranks, lying, and tricks—such as hiding a toad under her pillow or locking [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) in a toolhouse. Despite his chaotic behavior, Thirza works diligently to teach him right from wrong.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), +17 more_

- Commands — guardian giving orders and imposing discipline (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P29](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0029)</sub>
- Relative of — third cousins once removed (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P11](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0011), [v3 ch.Transgressors P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007)</sub>

### [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/pembroke--thirza-abernethy.md)

Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) is an acquaintance of Thirza whose daughter Isolde is close friends with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Their relationship experienced tension when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally served currant wine to Isolde, prompting Thirza to visit [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) to resolve Mrs. Pembroke's anger. After the misunderstanding was cleared up, the families restored their amicable ties.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P0](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), +10 more_

- Friend of — acquaintances and local figures who shared anger over children's phantom stories (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Autumn P28](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0028)</sub>
